name: map
useFor: Draw these on top of the product's map. On imagery, dim the photo with `ds-imagery`, use `tone="photo"` on the marker and a white scale. MapMarker fills its viewport; `x` and `y` are the point in viewport pixels. The example draws on live USGS orthoimagery and keeps its Forest ground offline.
constraints: Pins, drop shadows or round markers
A bright photo under the marks
source: Figma "UI · Map marker" (443:395) and the map exploration (449:2)
title: Map
description: The overlays on Mireye's map in one module: the survey marker and its tag, the scale bar and the zoom controls.
